_about: The publication's writers: Meet our writers (writers.html) and each writer's own page (writer-<slug>.html), both written by tools/pages/build.mjs (npm run pages) from this file, content/team.json and src/publication/pieces-data.js.

Each writer: id; name, exactly as printed on their pieces (their pieces are found by it); slug, their page's address; team, their id in content/team.json where they are on the core team (their photo and intro come from there unless their own are given here); photo, a WebP from the site's root (assets/writers/ or assets/team/), or null; intro, their introduction as paragraphs, or null; first (optional), the name to call them by where it is not the first word of their name.

awaiting: what has not come in yet. Until it does, a placeholder stands in: the publication's mark on a tile in the colour of their first piece, and 'Their introduction is on its way'. Send the photo (4:5, as the team's) to assets/writers/<slug>.webp and put it and the intro here, then take 'awaiting' away.
